note: Structure of the props Decky's routerHook passes to a patch for the Home route, captured read-only from Steam's gamepad router on the ROG Xbox Ally (SteamOS client, React 19.1.1) on 2026-10-03. Functions and symbols are recorded as descriptors and rebuilt by the test. Unlike /library/app/:appid there is no renderFunc: children is Steam's memo Home element with no props, which Decky wraps in a plain function component before calling the patch.

children._note: type/originalType describe what the patch receives: type is Decky's plain wrapper function around Steam's Home, not Steam's Home component itself; Steam's own Home type is the React.memo recorded as originalType.
